description: T-shirts, singlets and other vests, knitted, of cotton
classification_guidance: Knitted cotton T-shirts and vests without collars or buttons; cotton knit tops with collars may fall in 6110
evidence_required: Fibre composition and bill of materials; technical specification and construction description; samples and photographs; manufacturer statement on knitted versus woven fabric; commercial invoices and packing lists; comparable binding rulings

description: Jerseys, pullovers, cardigans, waistcoats and gilets, knitted or crocheted
classification_guidance: Knitted or crocheted garments covering the upper body. A knitted fleece gilet or knitted liner can classify here; padded outer garments with a woven shell lean to 6201/6202.
keywords: cotton knit tops knitted fleece gilet sleeveless pullover cardigan
evidence_required: Fibre composition and bill of materials; technical specification and construction description; samples and photographs; manufacturer statement on knitted versus woven fabric; commercial invoices and packing lists; comparable binding rulings

description: Women's anoraks, windcheaters, padded gilets and similar articles, woven
classification_guidance: Outer garments with a woven shell, including padded or quilted sleeveless gilets and body warmers. For a composite with a detachable liner, the shell that gives the essential character decides the heading.
keywords: padded gilet bodywarmer body warmer quilted sleeveless polyester shell jacket
evidence_required: Bill of materials with shell, wadding and liner composition and weights; construction sheet showing shell fabric is woven and how the liner is attached; sample and photographs; costing showing relative value of shell and liner; whether the liner is sold separately; comparable UK and EU binding rulings; commercial invoices

description: Men's anoraks, windcheaters, padded gilets and similar articles, woven
classification_guidance: Men's equivalent of 6202: woven outer garments including padded gilets and body warmers.
keywords: padded gilet bodywarmer quilted sleeveless polyester shell mens
evidence_required: Bill of materials; construction sheet; sample and photographs; comparable rulings; invoices

description: Footwear with outer soles of rubber, plastics or leather and uppers of leather
classification_guidance: Leather-upper footwear; textile uppers fall in 6404 and rubber/plastic uppers in 6402.
evidence_required: Upper and sole material specification; samples; invoices

classification_guidance: Batteries presented separately; batteries packed with or contained in equipment follow the equipment.
evidence_required: Battery watt-hour rating; UN38.3 test summary; safety data sheet

classification_guidance: Table, desk and portable fans; the built-in lithium battery follows the fan but is a dangerous-goods item when shipped by air.
evidence_required: Battery watt-hour rating; UN38.3 test summary; product specification
